description: Reference packet for the finite topological flux-sector calculation associated with issue #311. The objects are six flux sectors of a declared axis coefficient system on the certified icosahedral support: seam chains up to coboundary regauging, classified by puncture holonomy in its order-six class group. The carrier does not select the axis relation lattice, a physical global form, or a same-source identification with the matter-action kernel. The hash-pinned carrier manifest supplies the oriented twelve-vertex, thirty-seam, twenty-face complex, and the hash-pinned conditional global-form artifact supplies two-puncture witnesses for every class. The verifier derives exact twisted adjacency characteristic polynomials, local-coboundary invariance, Z6 fusion, finite composition of two selected seam-path-disjoint chains, persistence of the charge-conjugacy partition through one edge-midpoint refinement check, and the exact same-support classical stiffness realization K_k = 5 I - A_k. The regular Eisenstein blocks are checked in the positive hex-lattice metric G = [[2,1],[1,2]]: every phase is a G-isometry and G K_k equals the explicit symmetric edge sum-of-squares Hessian. A separately hash-pinned receipt constructs a two-component harmonic vector-spring realization for the different issue-634 local-domain sector and scalar spectral interface. No identity bridge between that 8662-node/1052-node local-domain calculation and the twelve-vertex/forty-two-vertex exact flux packet is claimed. Neither bounded result is a complete-interface ontology or extended-domain non-identifiability theorem. The packet does not construct asymptotic states, prove all-depth refinement stability, calibrate a mass, or identify a laboratory species.
